convention.image_space: +x right, +y down, origin at the top-left corner
convention.principal_point: this generator's lenses are built with cx = width / 2, half a pixel from OpenCV's (width - 1) / 2; read the value from intrinsics rather than assuming it
convention.equirectangular: longitude 0 is -Z and increases toward +X; latitude +90 is +Y at row 0; an integer coordinate is a pixel edge, so forward lands on the corner at (width / 2, height / 2)
convention.rotation: device -> world, unit quaternion, matching sphanorama::Quat
convention.pixel_encoding: each byte b is a signed component: value = b / 255 * 2 - 1, so 0 is -1.0, 128 is +0.00392 and 255 is +1.0; there is no gamma and no colour space. A consumer that assumes unsigned [0, 1] reads every frame with its contrast halved and its zero in the wrong place
